01

Local service business

Brags Global

Trade

Pressure washing, epoxy & flake floors, concrete coatings

Service area

Pinellas County, Florida

bragspressurewashing.com

The first screen does the selling: every service listed, quote and call buttons, and the trust signals customers look for before they pick up the phone.

The business

Brags Global cleans, coats and refinishes concrete for homes and businesses across Pinellas County. Pressure washing, epoxy and flake floors, stains and protective coatings.

What mattered

Six different services had to make sense at a glance. And asking for a price had to take one tap, whether a customer wants to call, text or send a request.

What we built

A dark, confident site with the full service list on the first screen, a photo card for every service, a simple three-step process and quote buttons throughout. Licensed & Insured and Locally Owned sit right under the headline.

Local service business · Call, text or request a quote · Residential & commercial

02

Tours & experiences

Xtreme Jet Ski Watersports

Business

Guided jet ski expeditions around Tampa Bay

Location

St. Petersburg, Florida

The business

Xtreme takes riders out of St. Petersburg on guided jet ski expeditions to sandbars, hidden islands and dolphin spots, with Captain Mike leading the way.

What mattered

Someone looking at a jet ski tour wants three answers fast: are you open, is there a spot, and how do I book? The site had to answer all three before anyone scrolls.

What we built

A bright, high-energy site over a full-screen water backdrop. Opening hours, Check Availability & Book and Call Now come first, then Captain Mike's guided expedition, then Google reviews. Tours, boating license info and FAQs are one click away.

xtremestpete.com

Hours, booking and a call button, all on the first screen.

The guided expedition gets its own spotlight, sold by the captain who leads it, with a button that books the 2-hour tour directly.

Tours & experiences · Online booking · Google reviews on the homepage

Visit the live site ↗

Live client website: xtremestpete.com. Opens in a new tab.

Not a template

Same industry. Same coast. Look again.

Xtreme and Aqua Safari both take people out on guided jet ski tours along Florida's Gulf Coast. On paper, they're the same kind of business. Here's how differently their websites introduce them.

Xtreme Jet Ski Watersports

Aqua Safari Jet Ski Adventures

Headline

A rounded, glowing all-caps wordmark

Towering condensed capitals

Palette

First words

Open Daily, Check Availability & Book, Call Now

“Clearwater Jet Ski Adventures Beyond the Ordinary”

What it sells

Captain Mike's guided expeditions

The islands: Three Rooker and Anclote Key

Trust

Google reviews right on the homepage

Real photos from their own tours and a meet-the-owner intro

Neither site could be swapped for the other.

That's the point.

03

Tours & experiences

Aqua Safari Jet Ski Adventures

Business

Guided island tours by jet ski

Launches from

The Anclote area, Tarpon Springs, Florida

Aqua Safari takes riders across the Gulf from Tarpon Springs to Three Rooker Island and Anclote Key. Its website had one job: make a first-timer want the trip, then get them booked.

03 · jetskiadventureclearwater.com

An adventure site that sells the islands

Built to sell the destination, not just the ride. Huge condensed headlines, photography from Aqua Safari's own tours, an introduction to the owner and guide, and a straight answer to “how far is it from Clearwater Beach?”

Dedicated sections for Three Rooker Island and Anclote Key

Book buttons throughout, connected to live online booking

First-timer questions answered before anyone has to call

Visit the live site ↗

Live client website: jetskiadventureclearwater.com. Opens in a new tab.

04

Skilled trades · Custom tile

The Tile Father

Business

Owner-operated custom tile installation

Service area

Tampa Bay, Pinellas, Sarasota & Manatee

The business

Lucas França runs The Tile Father and sets the tile himself: floors, kitchen backsplashes and custom feature work like marble inlay bands and hand-painted mural insets, across Tampa Bay.

What mattered

Craftsmanship deserves a website that looks as good as the finished work. People hiring for tile want to see real jobs, know exactly who will be in their home, and ask for an estimate without a runaround.

What we built

A calm, craftsmanship-first site that opens on a grid of Lucas's own project photos. Recent work lists the room, the location and the exact tile used, Lucas introduces himself as the one point of contact, and Get My Quote and Call Now appear from the first screen to the last.

thetilefather.com

Recent work reads like a job sheet: the room, where it is and the exact tile used, from real jobs Lucas has posted.

On a phone, the headline, Get My Quote and a call link all fit on the first screen.

Skilled trades · Owner-operated · Quote & call from the first screen
